fixes.explanation: That's the word, baker. Nehemiah says, "Please restore to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves, and houses, along with the percentage of the money, grain, new wine, and oil that you have been assessing them." (Nehemiah 5:11) No "let me get back to you." He wants it all restored immediately.
